description: Main window: native file dialogs, OS opener (open-path and, since UI-40, reveal-item-in-dir for *Open containing folder*), scoped asset reads for the covers cache (DR-44), the window commands the toolbar's own chrome needs (UI-07, D2): the three control buttons, the `start_dragging` call Tauri's drag-region script makes on the strip (DR-103), and `destroy`, which Tauri's own `onCloseRequested` plumbing calls to finish a close the app did not prevent (DR-105); and `set_size`, which only the smoke harness calls to measure the AC-35/AC-39 layouts at the window widths the ACs name — no product code calls it (DR-122). No other capability is granted (RULES R1.5).
